message: You know, there’s nothing quite like a surprise storm to remind you that you might not be as prepared as you thought. The last time we had a big rain, I found myself digging through old beach towels to soak up the puddles! 😅 It’s a good time to brush up on some reliable tips about flooding and safety — because being ready is a lot funnier than scrambling at the last minute. Have you checked your storm supplies lately?
